additional_info.subject: RE: ID0386111-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002741] DC2 OOO CRM:00579001242
additional_info.body:
Hello team,
Greetings of the day!
We checked and found the following error flags:
We could see that DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101 error :
With Attributes : VIV:0 RNE:1 KON:1
They states as
'VIV:'0 → in case of an invalid sensor reading
'RNE:'1 → in case of an sensor reading outside the defined operation range
So we need to check if the following connection from the Cable is fine or not. Also check all the connections to KF11 (EcoG) and KF13 (State monitor).
Also, Check if the Charging Plug to be tidy or have rust.
After all the above investigation, We may have to consider replacing the Cable.
Also, If cable replacement is considered, We need following information :
CP-to-ground Voltage reading (standby)
Signs of corrosion (external)
Evidence of water ingress
Outlet Number and position (e.g. DC1 - Left)
Cable lifetime from commissioning until replacement
You can refer to following KA -
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101 and EVSE_TempLowerLimit_ low temperature - Dynamics 365
Kindly follow the steps above and let us know your observations to proceed further.
We will wait for your feedback.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut

Hello,
Please inrom about the following:
CCS Cables - Formation of hotspots/corrosion/damage on metal pins
Complementary Information
- CCS Cables:
CP-to-ground Voltage reading (standby)
Signs of corrosion (external)
Evidence of water ingress
Picture of the Cable label
Outlet Number and position (e.g. DC1 - Left)
Cable lifetime from commissioning until replacement
Is it the original cable or has a cable replacement already taken place?
Date of CMS installation (if applicable)
Dates of last OK and first NOK session

Maximum charging current value (
EVSE_NowCur[A]
) of last 2 weeks before NOK session
